name: AUA Certification and Static Lifecycle Definition
description: Two correctness fixes to the AUA view in Advisor Intelligence Assets Overview. (1) Replace the current rolling-12M NMNC/NMEC classification with a static period-level definition: NMNC = clients whose first_seen_date falls within the displayed period; NMEC = all others. Restructure timeseries_chart.json aua key from a single daily series to three pre-aggregated period series (quarterly/monthly/annually). (2) Certify the current-period total AUA against the silver allocation parquet (BD's official daily snapshot). For the most recent period in each series, scale NMNC and NMEC proportionally so NMNC + NMEC = silver allocation total_aua. The rolling gradient definition is preserved conceptually but not wired to any v1 portal view.
